locations.name: Main Entrance
locations.description: The primary street-level entrance. Accessible ramp on the east side and a covered drop-off zone directly out front.

locations.name: Main Lobby
locations.description: Double-height reception area with the welcome desk, visitor check-in kiosks, and seating. Start any tour here.

locations.name: Grand Auditorium
locations.description: 220-seat auditorium used for keynotes and all-hands. Equipped with a full AV rig and a live-stream booth.

locations.name: Corner Cafe
locations.description: Coffee bar and grab-and-go counter. Open 7am-4pm on weekdays. Seating spills into the adjacent courtyard.

locations.name: Innovation Lab
locations.description: Hardware prototyping lab with 3D printers, a laser cutter, and electronics benches. Badge access required.

locations.name: Central Courtyard
locations.description: Landscaped open-air courtyard at the heart of the building. A quiet spot for breaks and informal meetings.
